note: Known differences between the Node CI domain (goldens/ci.json) and the Go one that are decisions, not bugs: ingest hardening of the artifact integers and cost (NFR6003/NFR6004, security note of the W1 contract notes) the zip integrity check, and (key prefix export/) the retirement of the export's unsupported_provider answer (FR24, D26). TestCIArtifactParity and TestCIZipParity fail when a listed case starts to agree, when an unlisted case disagrees and when a listed value changes. Consumers: ci_test.go and, for the export/ keys (listed Node and Go answers of golden steps, checked in both directions), ci/app/export_test.go TestExportGolden.

deviations.key: export/checks run in a fixed order/unsupported_provider

node.name: ValidationError
node.message: Only agents on the openrouter provider can be exported to CI

go.message: Select at least one valid pull_request trigger

deviations.reason: FR24, D26: an agent on openai (or anthropic, or a defined custom provider) is exportable, so the provider step passes and the step with `triggers: []` is refused one check later as invalid_triggers; no request answers unsupported_provider any more. Node refuses every non-openrouter agent at the provider step. The calls and logs of the step are unchanged (none).

Go-only hardening (NFR6003, ingest): integer fields are limited to JavaScript's safe range (2^53-1) because they are stored in integer columns; Node's zod int() accepts 1e21. The artifact is skipped as artifact_invalid instead of failing the insert on every refresh.
Same hardening as 'counts 1e21': integers above 2^53-1 are refused so a hostile artifact cannot make the insert fail on every refresh.
Go-only hardening: a cost that overflows to infinity is refused (it cannot be stored in the numeric cost column); Node's parse yields Infinity, which its schema accepts.

Node does not check the CRC-32 of an entry and returns the corrupted bytes (which then fail the schema: artifact_invalid); the Go reader verifies length and CRC-32 and refuses the entry. The artifact outcome is the same (zips/ case agrees).
